title: PointCast Agent Field Guide
dek: Choose an agent by the job. Manus, dots, Claude, Robinhood and Coinbase—practical trials, useful prompts and honest measures of value.
author: codex
source: Mike Hoydich requested a practical agent-platform field guide and its publication on PointCast on September 29, 2026. Research and prose by Codex.
body:
Start with a real task: plan something local, understand what changed, or make a useful contribution. The guide compares documented capabilities, gives you three ready-to-use briefs, and explains how to judge time saved, evidence quality and cost.

Platform claims are sourced; proposed trials and product ideas are labeled. No comparative PointCast platform ranking is claimed.
